title: Pistachio Crusted Australian Lamb Chops with Crispy Carrot Salad
description: Grilled lamb chops with a pistachio crust, served with a crispy carrot salad for a gluten-free meal.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400°F (200°C).
Season lamb chops with salt and pepper. Grill for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Meanwhile, mix pistachio meal and crispy shallots in a bowl. Brush lamb chops with olive oil and coat with pistachio mixture.
Toss chopped carrots with lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Grill for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly caramelized.
Serve lamb chops with crispy carrot salad and a side of your choice.
